description: Tron governance proposals: id, proposer, state, approvals, expiry and the parameters they would change. When to use: governance or staking questions, or checking whether a chain-parameter change is pending. Do not use: for the current parameter values (tron_get_chain_economics) or the witness list (tron_list_witnesses). Returns: total_proposals, by_state{}, top_by_approvals[] with proposal_id, proposer, approvals, state, parameters{}.

limit.description: How many top proposals to return (default 20)

name: tron_list_proposals
title: Tron List Proposals
